findings.title: translate() loads only config.locale, not fallback locales, breaking fallbacks outside controllers
findings.body: The patched translate() calls `load_locale(config.locale)` for the current I18n locale but never ensures the fallback locales (as defined by `I18n.fallbacks`) are loaded. ApplicationController#set_locale works around this by calling `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` on every request, but anything outside the controller request cycle (Sidekiq/background jobs, ActionMailer, rake tasks, the discourse console, plugin initialization, event handlers, etc.) does not run set_locale, so only config.locale's yml is loaded. When a key is missing in config.locale, I18n::Backend::Fallbacks#translate iterates `fallbacks[locale]` and calls Backend::Simple#translate for each fallback, but the yml files for those locales were never loaded, so the lookup misses and MissingTranslation is raised. The whole point of this PR is server-side fallbacks, so translate() itself should ensure the full chain is loaded, e.g. `ensure_loaded!(config.locale); I18n.fallbacks[config.locale].each { |l| ensure_loaded!(l) }`, rather than relying on a controller before_filter that is never invoked in those contexts.

findings.title: SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym raises NoMethodError when default_locale is nil
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList#[] builds the chain as `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact`. This initializer is loaded at boot, but `SiteSetting.default_locale` can legitimately be nil at that point (the setting is not yet populated from the DB, certain specs stub it, or it has been cleared). Calling `nil.to_sym` raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'to_sym' for nil:NilClass`, which propagates out of the initializer and prevents the app from booting. The trailing `.compact` does not protect against this because the exception is raised before compact runs. Guard against nil, e.g. `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale && SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact`, or coerce first.

findings.title: No tests added for the new localization fallback feature
findings.body: The PR introduces a non-trivial new class (FallbackLocaleList with custom [] and ensure_loaded!), a new I18n.ensure_loaded! method in the translate accelerator, and wires it into ApplicationController#set_locale, but the changed-files list contains no spec or test file. There are no specs covering: that missing keys in a user's locale fall back to SiteSetting.default_locale and then :en; that FallbackLocaleList#[] handles edge cases (nil default_locale, I18n.locale == :en, default_locale == :en, locale == default_locale); that ensure_loaded! loads every locale in the chain; or that translate() in translate_accelerator works correctly when fallbacks are exercised (both with and without options/args). Without these, regressions in fallback ordering or in the load_locale/ensure_loaded! interaction will be invisible.

findings.title: FallbackLocaleList subclasses Hash but only overrides [], losing Hash semantics like []= and breaking plugin custom fallbacks
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList < Hash overrides `[]` to always return a synthesized Array `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` and never stores anything in the underlying Hash. The standard `I18n::Locale::Fallbacks` it replaces also implements `[]=` (and relies on Hash#keys / merge / etc. in places), which lets plugins add per-locale mappings like `I18n.fallbacks[:'zh-TW'] = [:'zh-TW', :'zh-CN']`. With this class, any such `[]=` write is silently ignored: the next `fallbacks[:'zh-TW']` recomputes the generic `[locale, default_locale, :en]` chain and the plugin's mapping has no effect. Either subclass `I18n::Locale::Fallbacks` to keep the extension contract, store computed chains in the Hash and read them back in [], or stop inheriting from Hash and only expose the methods actually consumed by I18n::Backend::Fallbacks.
